title: GPU-Accelerated Computation of Persistent Homology for Topological Analysis of Image Data
gpu_scope: CUDA topoSort_kernel2D and topoSort_kernel3D inside a persistent-homology pipeline.
notes: Specialized to Morse/cubical-complex DAGs derived from image data; not a general edge-list DAG sorter. Retained as related GPU code, excluded from the general-problem target.
